title: ISP Tracking & DNS Privacy Policy Template
metaDescription: Comprehensive privacy policy template addressing ISP tracking, DNS monitoring, and data collection practices. Protect users from ISP surveillance.
description: A complete privacy policy template that addresses ISP tracking concerns, DNS monitoring practices, and user data protection measures. Helps organizations transparently communicate their stance on ISP surveillance and DNS privacy protection.

sections.heading: ISP Data Collection and Tracking
sections.content:
{{COMPANY_NAME}} recognizes that Internet Service Providers (ISPs) may monitor and collect data about users' online activities, including websites visited, DNS queries, and connection metadata. We are committed to protecting our users from ISP surveillance through the following measures:

• We do not share user browsing data with ISPs beyond what is technically necessary for service delivery
• We encourage users to employ encrypted DNS services and VPN protection
• We implement technical safeguards to minimize data exposure to ISP monitoring
• We support user privacy tools like Incognito Browser for enhanced browsing protection

sections.heading: DNS Privacy Protection
sections.content:
{{COMPANY_NAME}} implements DNS privacy measures to protect user queries from interception and manipulation:

• We support DNS over HTTPS (DoH) and DNS over TLS (DoT) protocols
• Our systems utilize encrypted DNS providers including {{DNS_PROVIDER}}
• We do not log or store DNS query information beyond technical requirements
• Users are informed about DNS hijacking risks and provided mitigation guidance
• We recommend secure DNS configurations to prevent ISP DNS manipulation

sections.heading: ISP Data Selling and Commercial Use
sections.content:
We acknowledge that many ISPs engage in the commercial sale of user browsing data and connection information. {{COMPANY_NAME}} addresses this concern by:

• Never purchasing or utilizing ISP-sold user data for marketing or profiling
• Educating users about their rights regarding ISP data collection
• Providing resources for users to opt-out of ISP data selling programs where available
• Recommending privacy tools and services that shield user activity from ISP monitoring
• Supporting legislative efforts to restrict ISP data collection and sale practices

sections.heading: Traffic Throttling and Deep Packet Inspection
sections.content:
{{COMPANY_NAME}} recognizes that ISPs may engage in traffic throttling, deep packet inspection, and content-based filtering. Our privacy protections include:

• Implementing encryption to prevent ISP content inspection
• Providing guidance on detecting and circumventing ISP throttling
• Supporting net neutrality principles in our service design
• Educating users about VPN services that prevent traffic analysis
• Monitoring for signs of ISP interference with our services

sections.heading: User Rights and ISP Protection Measures
sections.content:
Users have the right to protect their online activities from ISP monitoring. {{COMPANY_NAME}} supports these rights by:

• Providing clear information about ISP tracking capabilities
• Recommending privacy-enhancing tools including VPN services and encrypted browsers
• Offering guidance on configuring secure DNS settings
• Supporting users' choices to use privacy tools without service restrictions
• Maintaining transparency about any ISP-related data sharing requirements

sections.heading: Technical Safeguards and Encryption
sections.content:
{{COMPANY_NAME}} implements technical measures to protect user data from ISP surveillance:

• End-to-end encryption for all sensitive communications
• HTTPS enforcement across all services and platforms
• Encrypted DNS resolution to prevent query interception
• Regular security audits to identify ISP-related vulnerabilities
• Support for privacy-focused browsers and connection methods
• Implementation of {{ENCRYPTION_STANDARDS}} encryption standards

sections.heading: Policy Updates and User Notification
sections.content:
This ISP tracking and DNS privacy policy is effective as of {{EFFECTIVE_DATE}} and will be updated as privacy threats and protection measures evolve. Users will be notified of material changes through {{NOTIFICATION_METHOD}}. We encourage users to regularly review this policy and implement recommended privacy protections against ISP surveillance.

For questions about ISP tracking protection or DNS privacy measures, contact us at {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}.

useCases: Websites concerned about user ISP tracking and surveillance
Companies offering privacy-focused services and applications
Organizations that handle sensitive user browsing data
Platforms recommending VPN or DNS privacy tools to users
Businesses addressing customer concerns about ISP data selling
